label: B25-BRINGUP-BATCH
title: Integrate 25 MHz clock, initialized BRAM boot and polling JTAG-UART
scope: Merge the clock, BRAM monitor, JTAG-UART and EMIF resilience lanes into a board candidate that runs from initialized 64 KiB BRAM at a real 25 MHz CPU clock, reports calibration/DDR status, and provides polling JTAG-UART PING/PONG and character echo without IRQ, Flash or Linux.
writes: shared Makefile/test registry and Catapult SoC integration test
platform/skeleton manifests and checkers after member merge
rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_axi.sv::line-fill response correctness fixes discovered by integration

validation.L0: AArch64 build/disassembly, 64 KiB range, ELF-to-HEX/MIF byte equality and protocol constants
validation.L1: clock/reset, BRAM init, JTAG-UART Avalon DATA/CONTROL/RX/TX/backpressure and calibration/DDR directed SV/Cocotb
validation.L2: full Catapult SoC simulation from PC=0 observes LCVEX25 BOOT, READY, PONG, echo and real DDR adapter read/write counts
validation.L3: detached Gate D may overlap later GamePC physical work but must pass before board programming

acceptance: Merged candidate passes the affected local union; serial interaction remains available even if DDR calibration fails; no assembler, JTAG, power or board action is performed.
resource: Every local heavy run acquires local with >=8192 MiB admission, VERILATOR_JOBS=1 and measured resources. Return 75 means wait.
forbidden_regions: assembler, quartus_pgm, JTAG, power-on or board test
integration_discoveries: AArch64 post-index load using SP is not yet implemented correctly; B25 firmware uses explicit SUB/STR and LDR/ADD stack sequences.
MMU-off DDR must bypass L1/L2 for a deterministic real adapter magic test.
AXI line-fill first response previously returned the final beat low word and offset 7 was skipped; both are fixed with a dedicated offset0..7 regression.

result.status: accepted; affected union, final Gate D/physical/assembler and corrected board interaction pass
remaining_gates: repeat full-FP fresh physical and board signoff before a full-FP release
close external DDR calibration and Linux board acceptance separately

sof_package.status: pass; Quartus assembler Successful, 0 errors/0 warnings, exactly one volatile SOF

board_attempt.status: initial frozen-SOF attempt failed; corrected successor chain completed BRAM boot, bidirectional polling JTAG-UART and exact golden recovery
board_attempt.corrected_closeout_status: candidate functional PASS with BOOT/READY/?/PONG/RXDBG/Z and RXPATH/RXCPU acceptance
board_attempt.golden_recovery_status: PASS; live exact golden identity proven
board_attempt.root_cause: proven: rtl/lcvex_bram_boot.sv synthesis-only altera_syncram response captured stale req_q on the address-accept edge
board_attempt.boundary: external DDR remains DDR-FAIL; full-FP release and Linux board acceptance are separate gates
